name: NumberTicker
description: Counts from a start value to a target with an expo-out ease when scrolled into view, with fixed decimals, tabular numerals, and optional prefix and suffix.
a11yNotes: The root exposes the final formatted value (with prefix and suffix) via role="img" and aria-label, so assistive tech never reads intermediate numbers. The server-rendered text is the final value; under prefers-reduced-motion it stays final with no count animation.

propsApi.name: value
propsApi.description: Target value to count up to.

propsApi.name: decimals
propsApi.description: Number of fraction digits to display.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
